items.title: George Masso interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 10, 1997
items.q: I know Bill Crow very well. I just spoke with Bill on the phone two days ago.

ctx.x: Did you ever see the book Jazz Anecdotes?

Yes, I’ve seen it, I know Bill Crow very well. I just spoke with Bill on the phone two days ago. What a wonderful writer, and what a great musician, a wonderful bassist. And there’s some great stories in there, and they’re all true.
He included one that you’re in. With Vic Dickinson? Do you recall that?
